title: Sea Leveler
specs: Fishing grounds near Cocoa Beach, Cape Canaveral, and Port Canaveral shoals
Catch a variety of species including sharks, tuna, mahi, red drum, grouper, tarpon
Boats equipped with restrooms and lighting
Maximum 6 passengers per boat due to US Coast Guard licensing
Children over 2 years old welcome; child size USCG approved life vests available
Up to 6 people per boat; larger groups can book multiple boats
includes: Rod, reels, bait, tackle, ice, and fishing license
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests fish for a variety of species including sharks, tuna, mahi, and bottom fish. Trips range from short shark fishing excursions to full day and specialty trips targeting specific species. Boats are equipped with fishing gear, restrooms, and captains provide instruction and encouragement for all skill levels.
extraNote: Price is for entire group, not per person · Private charters only; no shared charters · Tips customary at 20% for good service · Deck hand available on request for additional $75 · Shark trips depart at 5pm; timing may vary depending on day trip filleting · Sunrise Marina behind Grills Seafood Deck and Tiki Bar, Port Canaveral, FL · Year round
